sn16.10:3.2: Ānanda was from Sakya, not Videha, a problem that evidently vexed the commentators. The Pali commentary explains _vedeha_ as “learned”. The Mahāvastu, on the other hand, says that after the Buddha went forth, Ānanda went to Videha and undertook a vow of silence (_maunavrata_, Mvu 83; Senart 3.176). The Mūlasarvastivāda Vinaya says rather that it was on Mount Videha that the Buddha entrusted Ānanda with the design for the robes (Mu Kd 7; GBM 6.814). None of these are cogent. The point is that Thullatissā was such an idiot, she didn’t even know where Ānanda came from.
sn16.10:6.4: This note is in the Pali text. It is referring to the previous Sutta.
sn16.10:9.1: Text has _sattaratana_, seven “cubits”, i.e. the length from elbow to fingertips, or about 45 cm.
